arguments.value: Edward Milton Chen is a U.S. District Judge for the Northern District of California, taking senior status in 2022 after nearly eleven years on the bench and a prior decade as a magistrate judge. Born in Oakland in 1953, he earned his A.B. and J.D. from the University of California, Berkeley, and began his legal career with clerkships for Judge Charles B. Renfrew and Judge James R. Browning. He went on to work for the Asian Law Caucus, practice privately in San Francisco, and serve as a staff attorney with the American Civil Liberties Union Foundation of Northern California from 1985 to 2001 before his judicial appointments. Nominated to the district court by President Barack Obama and confirmed in 2011, Judge Chen has brought extensive experience in civil rights, appellate, and federal court practice to the federal bench.
